title: Erdős–Szekeres #699：二项式系数的公共“大”素因子
summary: Terminal certified finite result: i=3 is verified for every 8<=n<=100000000. A fast fail-closed binder now fixes n_min, n_max, i, both 43631335536 counts, certificate/source/output hashes, and the C++ build command; its external-cwd normal/-O tamper matrix passes. Three bounded novelty passes, citation/LaTeX audits, a clean build, and five-page PDF inspection pass. The original conjecture remains open.
solution_percent_basis: Conservative assessment of the original infinite problem: i=1,2 are proved and a large but finite i=3 prefix is certified; the unbounded i=3 tail and general i>=4 strata remain open.
confidence_percent_basis: 98% confidence applies only to the delimited finite theorem: an iff completeness reduction, two full exact implementations, direct-gcd overlap, frozen output, hash/count binder, and fail-closed tamper matrix support it. It is not confidence that the full conjecture is true.
